from.place: Proof, paragraph 1: the descended natural transformation is an isomorphism once its finite-stage components are isomorphisms

title: Natural transformation isomorphism criterion
statement: For any categories $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ [def-nagata-category], functors $F,G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, and a natural transformation $\tau:F\Rightarrow G$, $\tau$ is an isomorphism if and only if $\tau_X$ is an isomorphism for every object $X$ of $\mathcal C$.
